annotations.title: Check which environment variables reach the browser

description: Takes environment variable NAMES (never values) and says, for each one, whether the build tool ships it to every visitor (VITE_, NEXT_PUBLIC_, EXPO_PUBLIC_, REACT_APP_, PUBLIC_, GATSBY_, NUXT_PUBLIC_) and whether its name looks like a server secret that must not be there. Use when someone asks whether their .env or API keys are exposed in a Lovable, Bolt, Vite, Next.js or Expo app. Send names only; if a value is included it is dropped and not stored. Explanations are in Hebrew.
name: check_env_exposure
title: Check which environment variables reach the browser
